register.title: Benefits register (T14)
register.intro: Every benefit of this transformation, counted once. Pending values are kept apart from validated and sustained values.
register.tableIntro: Value (SAR) n/a means a non-financial benefit without an approved valuation method; it is never counted as zero. Unknown is shown with its reason.
register.emptyBody: Create the first benefit at the Identify step.

realization.enabled_not_yet_measured: Enabled, not yet measured (not realized value)

exclusion.parent_rollup: Not counted: a parent is the roll-up of its children
exclusion.group_counted_member_not_named: Not counted: its shared-benefit group has no counted member yet
exclusion.group_member_not_counted: Not counted: another member of its shared-benefit group is counted
exclusion.overlap_duplicate: Not counted: Finance resolved an overlap as a duplicate of another benefit

counting.overlapOpen: Open overlap warning: excluded from validated and sustained totals until Finance resolves it

amount.naLong: Non-financial benefit without an approved valuation method: no SAR value, excluded from SAR totals, never counted as zero

realized.pendingLabel: Pending Finance validation: not counted as validated

field.title: Title
field.counterfactual: Counterfactual (what would happen without the change)
field.missingReason: Why the value is not available

form.createIntro: A new benefit starts at Identify. Give it one owner, a type and a value class that fits the type. A financial benefit needs a financial-statement line; a non-financial one needs an agreed KPI.
form.classHint: The classes follow the type: revenue uplift and margin are revenue classes; cash saving and avoided cost are cost classes. They are never converted into each other.
form.currencyHint: Three letters, for example SAR. Values are never converted between currencies.
form.kpiHint: A non-financial benefit is measured by its agreed KPI.
form.methodHint: Without an approved method a non-financial benefit has no SAR value (n/a).
form.moneyHint: A decimal number, for example 250000.50. Leave empty when not known (it stays Unknown, never 0).
form.formulaHint: Required before Enable for a financial benefit.
form.keyHint: Lower-case letters, digits and . _ : - (for example prepaid.churn). Two benefits with the same driver and overlapping dates raise an overlap warning.
form.validatorHint: Leave empty to route to the transformation's Finance role. The owner cannot validate.
form.recoveryHint: Required to enter the Correct step.
form.ragHint: Leave empty when not assessed: it is shown as Unknown, never as on track.

benefit.title: Benefit
benefit.intro: Profile, lifecycle, enablers, allocations, values and measurements of one benefit.
benefit.archivedNote: This benefit is archived and read-only. Reason: {{reason}}
benefit.kpiMeasured: Measured by its agreed KPI (no formula needed)

baseline.note: Finance confirms the baseline is the comparison basis. Values of this benefit can be validated only after its baseline is validated.

lifecycle.title: Benefits lifecycle
lifecycle.intro: Six steps from the playbook, each with its question and output. A benefit moves one step at a time; a step can start only when its outputs are present.
lifecycle.question: Question
lifecycle.arProvisional: Provisional Arabic translation of the playbook text.
lifecycle.advanceIntro: The server checks the outputs again and refuses the move if any is missing.
lifecycle.order: Order: {{steps}}. Measure and Correct can alternate; Sustain follows Measure.

enablers.title: Enablers
enablers.intro: The initiatives, deliverables or capabilities that enable this benefit. A delivered enabler is not realized value.
enablers.empty: No enabler linked. At least one is needed before Measure.
enablers.deliveredNotRealized: Delivered: an enabler, not proof of realized value.

allocations.title: Contribution allocations
allocations.intro: How this benefit is attributed to initiatives. Shares total at most 100 %; the rest is unallocated.
allocations.editIntro: Saving replaces the whole set. The server refuses a total above 100 %.
allocations.shareHint: Above 0 and at most 100, up to 4 decimals.
allocations.countedOnce: Allocations attribute the benefit to initiatives for their views. Transformation totals count the benefit once, never its allocations.

values.title: Values by state
values.intro: Planned, forecast, submitted (pending), validated, sustained, rejected and measured values are kept apart and never added together. A forecast is never validated.
values.addPlan: Add a planned or forecast value
values.planIntro: In {{currency}}. Give an amount or a KPI value.

stateNote.measured: Everything measured (overlaps submitted and validated; not a separate total).
stateNote.submitted: Pending Finance validation; not counted as validated.

measurements.title: Measurements
measurements.intro: A measured value is pending until Finance validates it. A validated value is never edited: Finance records an amendment or a reversal.
measurements.submitIntro: The value goes to the Finance validation queue. The validated total does not change until Finance approves it.
measurements.submitNow: Submit for Finance validation now (otherwise it is saved as a draft)
measurements.formIntro: Values in {{currency}}. Give an amount, a KPI value, or why the value is not available (it then stays Unknown, never 0).
measurements.periodHint: The measurement period is required before submitting.
measurements.kpiValueHint: For a non-financial benefit: the KPI actual.
measurements.missingHint: Use this only when no value can be given.
measurements.noEvidence: The transformation has no evidence yet. A submission needs at least one piece of evidence.
measurements.draftNote: A draft is not submitted and is not counted anywhere.
measurements.notAtMeasure: This benefit is at the {{step}} step. Measurements start at Measure: a delivered enabler is not realized value.
measurements.open: Open the measurement and its lineage
measurements.provisionalLong: Provisional: the baseline or formula version is not validated by Finance, so this value is excluded from validated totals and cannot be validated yet.
measurements.validatedImmutableLong: A validated value is never edited. Finance corrects it with an amendment or a reversal; every record stays visible.
measurements.pendingNote: Pending Finance validation: the value is not counted as validated until Finance approves it.

lineage.title: Measurement and lineage
lineage.intro: Where the value came from: formula version, inputs, rates, assumptions and period.
lineage.calcIntro: The formula version and the exact input values used. Formula versions never change after use.
lineage.formulaVariable: Rate or variable of the formula version

finance.label: Finance validation
finance.labelNote: a Finance decision recorded in this product. It is not an engineering delivery gate.
finance.orgIntro: Submitted benefit values waiting for Finance, across the transformations you can read, oldest first.
finance.queueIntro: One item per submitted value. Pending values are not validated until Finance approves them.
finance.detailIntro: The six items Finance checks, the decision, and corrections.
finance.someUnreadable: {{count}} transformation queues could not be read.
finance.submitterCannotDecide: You submitted this value, so you cannot validate it.
finance.provisional: The comparison basis is not validated by Finance, so this value is provisional and approval will be refused. Validate the benefit's baseline (and its formula version) first.
finance.itemsIntro: Finance accepts or rejects each item. Approval needs all six accepted.
finance.decideNote: decide each of the six items, then approve or reject. An item left undecided is refused by the server with the missing items named.
finance.approvedAmountHint: The amount added to the validated total.
finance.amendNote: The validated value is not edited. A linked amendment records the difference to the corrected amount.
finance.reverseNote: The validated value is not edited. A linked reversal nets it to zero; both records stay visible.

totals.title: Totals
totals.intro: Each benefit counted once. One line per value class and state; states are never added together. Currencies are never converted.
totals.portfolioIntro: The transformations you can read, each benefit counted once.
totals.byClassCaption: Totals by value class and state
totals.noLines: No values in this currency yet.
totals.netNote: Net = gross − implementation cost. Valued non-financial benefits are shown on their own line and are not in gross.
totals.nonFinancialCount: Non-financial benefits without a valuation method
totals.nonFinancialNote: Value n/a: excluded from SAR totals, not counted as zero.
totals.pendingOverlapNote: values of benefits with an open overlap warning, outside validated and sustained totals until Finance resolves the warning.
totals.allocatedNote: Initiative view: allocated shares of each benefit. Never added to the transformation total.

groups.title: Shared-benefit groups
groups.intro: Benefits that claim one economic pool. Exactly one member is counted.
groups.rule: Until a counted member is named, no member of the group is counted, so a shared benefit is never double counted. Benefits join a group from their profile.
groups.noneCounted: None named: no member is counted
groups.countedHint: Must be a member. Only this benefit is counted in totals.
groups.membersHint: Members join or leave through each benefit's profile (Shared-benefit group).
groups.emptyBody: Create one when several benefits claim the same value.

overlaps.title: Overlap warnings
overlaps.intro: Possible double counts between two benefits.
overlaps.rule: Two benefits with the same value driver and overlapping dates raise a warning. While it is open, both are excluded from validated and sustained totals until Finance resolves it.
overlaps.excludedWhileOpen: Both benefits are excluded from validated totals while open.
overlaps.excludedWhileOpenLong: While this warning is open, both benefits are excluded from validated and sustained totals and their values are shown on a separate pending-overlap line.
overlaps.ownerCannotResolve: You own one of these benefits, so you cannot resolve this overlap.
overlaps.raiseIntro: Name two benefits and what they overlap on. Finance then resolves it.
overlaps.resolveNote: Finance decides whether the two benefits overlap economically. A duplicate excludes one of them from every total.

resolution.no_economic_overlap: No economic overlap: both are counted

overlaps.emptyBody: Warnings appear when two benefits share a driver and dates.

scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.intro: Base, upside and downside views of the benefits.
scenarios.rule: Every scenario value is labelled with its kind. Scenario values are never actuals and never enter realized or validated totals.
scenarios.archiveHint: Fill in only to archive the scenario.
scenarios.valueIntro: A {{kind}} value. It never counts as realized or validated.

methods.title: Valuation methods
methods.intro: How a non-financial benefit may be given a SAR value.
methods.rule: A method is proposed by a benefit editor and decided by Finance (not the proposer). Without an approved method a non-financial benefit has no SAR value (n/a).
methods.name: Name
methods.decideNote: Finance approves, rejects or retires a valuation method. A retired method stays valid for benefits that already use it.
methods.proposerCannotDecide: You proposed it, so you cannot decide it.
methods.emptyBody: Propose one to value a non-financial benefit in SAR.
